prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Pleasanton California?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t reliably name a single “best” personal injury lawyer for Pleasanton — that depends on the exact facts of your case and what matters most to you (experience, trial record, communication style, fees). I can, however, help you find the right lawyer and give guidance on choosing one.

What you can do now
- Narrow what you need: car accident, slip & fall, dog bite, workplace injury, catastrophic injury, wrongful death, medical malpractice, etc.
- Use these trusted resources to find highly rated attorneys near Pleasanton:
  - CA State Bar “Find a Lawyer” (to check license and discipline)
  - Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Lawyers.com
  - Google Reviews and Yelp (client feedback)
  - Local bar associations (Alameda County / Tri-Valley)

How to evaluate candidates
- Experience with your specific type of injury and with Alameda County courts
- Track record: settlements and trial verdicts for similar cases
- Resources: does the firm have investigators/experts if your case needs them?
- Communication: who will handle the case and how often will they update you?
- Fee structure: most PI lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you win). Ask the contingency percentage and who pays costs if you lose.
- Availability for a free consultation and whether they’ll give a preliminary case assessment

Important question list to ask at the first consultation
- How many similar cases have you handled? What were the outcomes?
- Do you take cases to trial or settle mostly? How many trials have you tried?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee (contingency %) and what costs might I be responsible for?
- What is your estimate of the case timeline and potential value?
- Can you provide references or recent client testimonials?

Timing (urgent)
- California’s general statute of limitations for personal injury is two years from the injury (there are important exceptions). Don’t delay contacting an attorney if you’ve been injured.

If you’d like, tell me:
- The type of injury and a few facts (date, severity, injuries, insurance involved), and I’ll suggest what to look for in attorneys handling that kind of case and can draft an email/script to use when contacting them. If you want, I can also create a prioritized checklist to compare 3–5 lawyers you find. Which would you prefer?
